item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Sant Roch Offers Contrast Therapy in an Immersive, Social Setting
item.description: Its first location, in Paris, will open March 2.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Matrix Names Katseye Its New Global Ambassadors
item.description: This marks the first hair care partnership for the Grammy-nominated girl group.

item.title: At Net-a-porter and Mr Porter, It’s All About the Customer
item.description: Heather Kaminetsky and Toby Bateman talk about their strategies for Net-a-porter and Mr Porter, respectively under new ownership and why the customer informs every move they make.

item.title: LuxExperience’s Michael Kliger Talks Turnaround, Best Practices and Luxury
item.description: The CEO updates how the company is managing its acquisition of Yoox Net-a-porter and initiatives raising profitability.

item.title: CEO TALKS: Iguatemi’s Ciro Neto on Brazil’s Retail Renaissance
item.description: "At our flagship properties, gastronomy, beauty and culture have become major traffic drivers," according to the executive, now one year in the role.

item.title: Bode to Open Store in Tokyo’s Yoyogi-Uehara Neighborhood
item.description: The store marks the fifth globally for the designer and its first in Asia.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Longchamp Earns B Corp Certification, Practices Across Its Vertically Integrated Model
item.description: To gain certification, the family-owned company boosted supply chain oversight and cut transport emissions.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Bulgari Taps Dua Lipa as Global Brand Ambassador
item.description: The artist said the Italian jeweler's pieces "always add the perfect finishing touch, transforming a look into a real moment.”

item.title: The Secret Sauce of Mytheresa
item.description: In his first interview as CEO of Mytheresa, Francis Belin discusses why the luxury website transcends the troubled fashion e-commerce sector, and how it can keep growing.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: In Givenchy’s New Campaign, Annie Leibovitz Shows Up on the Other Side of the Camera
item.description: Creative director Sarah Burton also cast artist Isabelle Albuquerque, along with models Kaia Gerber, Liu Wen and Selena Forrest.
